purpose: Explain weak enhancement and adjudicate ASR candidates before any method design
forward_probe_selection: all seven ASR regression candidates plus the first nonregression by sample_id for each of six speakers; selection fixed before probe outputs
audit_checks: original prepare_time_domain with pair-to-complex ISTFT compatibility only
interpretation_limits: coefficient projections are descriptive, not true separated speech/noise components
channel permutation is an out-of-domain sensitivity probe, not an enhancement baseline
clean-input distortion does not by itself establish lost words
no human listening is inferred from ASR or plots

human_feedback_received.question_scope: whether JUST is harder to hear after enhancement
human_feedback_received.answer_verbatim: 两者都能听清，没有明显退步
human_feedback_received.interpretation: user-reported no obvious regression for this word; not a blinded listening study or all-case judgement

new_utterance_confirmation: only if an operational acoustic failure is supported; otherwise do not create a nominal confirmation set without a hypothesis
